verdict.rationale: Temporal ships an extensively documented programmatic surface — CLI (docs.temporal.io/cli), multi-language SDKs (docs.temporal.io/develop/typescript, /python), and core primitives (Workflows, Activities, Signals/Queries/Updates, Schedules) all publicly documented, with runtime probes confirming the CLI works locally and docs.temporal.io is agent-legible (llms.txt, .md mirrors, and an auth-gated MCP endpoint for agents). This lets an AI-native user drive Temporal via well-documented interfaces rather than reverse-engineering it. Missing for 10: a formal OpenAPI/REST spec (probes found openapi.json/swagger.json all 404), and independent third-party confirmation of API completeness beyond Temporal's own docs.
